test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 10 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

Though many of my family members can cook well, __I can cook more well than others.__

options.text: I can cook best than others
I can cook more good than others
I can cook good than others
I can cook better than others

solution:
The correct answer is, **'I can cook better than others.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Another way of saying 'more well' is better.
 
• Superlative degree is used for comparison.
